summary_claims.claim: lawyers must research a program's policies on data retention, data sharing and self-learning; informed consent before disclosing confidential information to a third-party program
chatbots must disclose they are an AI program and not a lawyer or employee; no inflated billed time; may not delegate practice of law

scope.note: Advisory opinion of The Florida Bar, an integrated bar under the Supreme Court of Florida but also a professional body; included under the inclusive default. The scope_note refers to process ('until a scope decision settles'), which a human may want to reword.

note: Quotes verified in the Buffalo CLE copy; the Bar's own page was not stored, so level C. No revision or withdrawal found in one search. Scope of state bar opinions is not settled by the precedents; the extractor's open question should go to a human, but the record stays in under the inclusive rule.
